content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The Kanika catamaran offers a 90-minute "Sunset Cruise on the Mekong" departing at 5:00 PM, providing views of the Royal Palace from the Chaktomuk river confluence (Mekong, Tonle Sap, Bassac rivers). This luxury experience is available year-round and includes signature cocktails.
> *   AGS clients benefit from priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for the Kanika cruise, ensuring a seamless, high-end experience without logistical friction. The cruise is designed for a peaceful, scenic atmosphere with no physical demand.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Escape the frantic heat of the capital. Drift along the historic 'Four Faces' river confluence at dusk aboard a spacious, beautifully appointed French-style catamaran.

## The Operator & Origin Story
The intersection of the Mekong, Tonle Sap, and Bassac rivers (Chaktomuk) heavily dictated the location of the capital. High-end cruising operators like Kanika offer the most relaxed, civilized method of viewing the city's transitioning skyline.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Board the Kanika catamaran at 5:00 PM. Unlike the cramped tourist boats, the catamaran offers significant deck space and stability. 

You are served a signature cocktail precisely as the boat positions itself for the ultimate sunset view behind the spires of the Royal Palace. The cruise lasts 90 minutes, providing a profoundly peaceful transition from day to evening.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Peaceful, Scenic, Breezy |
| **Duration** | 1.5 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | Pre-dinner drinks in Phnom Penh. |

## Golden-Hour Recovery on the Four Rivers After Playing Vattanac or Garden City
Departing from the riverside boardwalk in Phnom Penh at 5:00 PM—just 10 minutes from [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/) and [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/)—the **Kanika Sunset Cruise on the Mekong** is a breezy, zero-exertion 90-minute catamaran voyage across the *Chaktomuk* ("Four Faces") confluence where the Upper Mekong, Lower Mekong, Tonle Sap, and Bassac rivers intersect. After a morning tee time at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/), [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/), or [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/), stepping aboard the twin-hulled wooden catamaran with a chilled G&T as the golden roofs of the Royal Palace glow at dusk is the most restorative pre-dinner transition in the capital.

## Private Upper-Deck Charter & Onboard Hospitality
* **Reserved Bow Lounge or Full-Vessel Charter:** For fourballs and couples, Asia Golf Specialists reserves cushioned front-deck lounge tables away from standard seating; for groups of 8 to 16 golfers on [The Khmer Kingdom Links](/tours/the-khmer-kingdom-links/), we charter the catamaran privately with a customized open bar and hot tapas menu.
* **Seamless Pier-to-Restaurant Transfers:** Disembarking at 6:30 PM places your party right in time for a 7:00 PM dinner reservation at *Malis* (Cambodian fine dining by Chef Luu Meng), *Cuts* on the 38th floor of [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/), or a craft-cocktail evening along [Bassac Lane](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-bassac-lane-phnom-penh/).

## Combining the Kanika Mekong Sunset Cruise With Vattanac Night Golf & Capital Dining
Because Phnom Penh offers both morning championship tee sheets at [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/) and [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/) as well as floodlit evening golf at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/), we schedule the 5:00 PM Kanika Mekong Sunset Cruise on the afternoon of your morning round. After disembarking along Sisowath Quay at 6:30 PM, your standby luxury MPV transfers your group in under 10 minutes to [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) or [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/) for dinner, leaving the following late afternoon free for floodlit twilight golf on [Vattanac West Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/). Guests staying along the riverfront or in central Daun Penh enjoy private dockside boarding assistance, cold lemongrass towels upon embarkation, and curated regional wine pairings throughout the voyage.

faqs.q: Where does the Kanika Mekong Sunset Cruise depart in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: The Kanika catamaran boards along Phnom Penh's Sisowath Quay riverfront near the Himawari pier, a 10-minute private SUV transfer from Rosewood Phnom Penh and Raffles Hotel Le Royal.

faqs.q: Can we pair the Mekong Sunset Cruise with a morning round at Vattanac Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Yes. Teeing off at 7:30 AM at Vattanac Golf Resort or Chhun On Golf Resort gets you back to your hotel by 1:00 PM for lunch and rest before your 4:30 PM transfer to the 5:00 PM sunset boarding.

faqs.q: Can a golf group charter a private Mekong sunset boat in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Absolutely. For groups of 6 to 16 golfers, Asia Golf Specialists arranges private sunset catamaran or traditional wooden cruiser charters with free-flow premium spirits, cold Angkor beer, and Khmer canapés.
